scripts.pdf: if [ -n "$CHROME_BIN" ]; then "$CHROME_BIN" --headless --print-to-pdf=public/captainslog.pdf --no-pdf-header-footer file://$(pwd)/public/pdf/index.html; else "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --print-to-pdf=public/captainslog.pdf --no-pdf-header-footer file://$(pwd)/public/pdf/index.html; fi; cp public/captainslog.pdf content/captainslog.pdf;
scripts.build: hugo; npm run images; npm run pdf
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --no-build --dir=public --prod --site=$NETLIFY_SITE_ID
